stress_testing.methodology: Factor Beta Sensitivity and Historical Analogue Elasticity

scenarios.name: Sharp USD Appreciation (Dollar Rally)
scenarios.historical_analogue: 2014-2015 ECB QE & Fed Divergence Dollar Surge
scenarios.risk_transmission: Gold is internationally denominated in USD. A stronger dollar makes bullion more expensive in foreign currencies, dampening non-US demand and prompting fund liquidation.

scenarios.name: Rising US Real Yields (Hawkish Fed Shock)
scenarios.historical_analogue: 2013 Taper Tantrum & 2022 Fed Rate Hiking Cycle
scenarios.shock_magnitude: US 10-Year Real Yield (TIPS) surges by +175 bps
scenarios.risk_transmission: As zero-yielding store of value, gold competes directly against safe real return on US Treasuries. Rapid increases in real yields raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding bullion.

scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation (Crisis Safe-Haven Flight)
scenarios.historical_analogue: February 2022 Russia-Ukraine Outbreak & 2023 Middle East Escalation
scenarios.shock_magnitude: Global Geopolitical Risk Index (GPR) surges > 3 standard deviations
scenarios.risk_transmission: Institutional capital and sovereign reserve managers flee sovereign sanction risks and financial counterparty exposure toward physical unencumbered bullion.

scenarios.name: Persistent Inflation Surprises (Stagflation Risk)
scenarios.shock_magnitude: Headline CPI prints run +2.5% above central bank targets with slowing growth
scenarios.risk_transmission: Negative real cash returns incentivize wealth preservation in hard monetary assets; historical bullion purchasing power preserved during stagflationary regimes.

scenarios.name: Central-Bank Demand Slowdown
scenarios.shock_magnitude: Official sector net annual purchases drop by 50% (from ~1,000t/yr to 500t/yr)
scenarios.risk_transmission: Official sector reserve de-dollarization has served as the marginal structural price-setter since 2022. Halving purchase velocity removes persistent structural buying bid.

scenarios.name: USD/INR Exchange Rate Shock (Rupee Depreciation)
scenarios.historical_analogue: 2013 Fragile Five Rupee Tumble & 2022 USD/INR Breakout
scenarios.shock_magnitude: USD/INR exchange rate depreciates by +8.0% (e.g. from 94.9 to ~102.5 INR/USD)
scenarios.risk_transmission: Because domestic Indian prices track parity (Spot USD * FX * 0.3215 * Duty/Taxes), Rupee weakness causes immediate proportionate surge in domestic INR bullion prices.
